_comment: Per-project **BUILD** gate. It runs DURING a phase. `tests` is REQUIRED: a phase with a red suite does not pass. The tests check runs this project's own test command from .claude/builder-kit.json (written per type at scaffold: web npm test, ios xcodebuild test, agent npm run eval), falling back to npm test if that config is absent, so a green checkpoint means the REAL suite passed. If your very first phase has no tests yet, that failure is correct — write them. Tighten further per phase in docs/checkpoints/phase-<n>.json.
_split: The acceptance-criteria row is deliberately NOT here. It lives in checkpoint-close.json beside this file, and per phase in docs/checkpoints/phase-<n>-close.json. A gate that demands ticked criteria before the evidence pass has run fails by construction on every first close, and the only way through is to tick the boxes to make it green — which inverts evidence-then-tick into tick-to-go-green. Do not add a checklist-done row here.
_tokens: {{PLUGIN_SCRIPTS}} expands to the plugin's scripts directory at run time, so these rows keep working after the plugin updates. checkpoint.mjs does the substitution.
